entries.say.1.neutral: Damn {slot.killer.name}. {target.name} stood with {slot.faction.name}; we will answer for this.
entries.say.2.neutral: One of ours is down, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} made enemies of all of us.
entries.say.3.neutral: We saw {slot.killer.name} take {target.name}. This is not finished.
entries.say.4.neutral: {slot.killer.name} killed a member of {slot.faction.name}. We will remember.
entries.say.5.neutral: Run while you can, {slot.killer.name}. We will not forget what happened to {target.name}.
entries.say.6.neutral: Hell, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} will pay for making us weaker.
entries.say.7.neutral: {slot.faction.name} lost one today. {slot.killer.name} started something they cannot finish.
entries.say.8.neutral: We do not forget our own, {target.name}. {slot.killer.name} will answer for this.
